display.title: Engineering II - Thermal Series
display.subtitle: Submit Thermal-tier machines
description: Tier 2 engineering is the Thermal Series. The bulk-metal caps widen and
Thermal machines carry the heavy token values.
Sample submissions from the T2 table:
- Gold / Iron / Copper / Redstone - now capped at 15000 each
- Induction Smelter, Pulverizer, Centrifugal Separator - 40-50 each
- Dynamos, Energy Cells, the Sawmill - mid value
Submit a Machine Frame and a Redstone Furnace to bank Thermal tokens.
The full table reaches ~120% of the 1000-token Tier 3 threshold.
